Player Impressions:
Hoyos - D.C. didn't really do much in the 2nd half.  He didn't have much to do.  Didn't have to make an official save 🧤 🧤.
Báez - very good performance.  Great attacking movement.  Constantly getting open.  Sending in quality crosses.
Alonso - Long balls were looking pretty.  Surprised he was subbed off.
Mihaj - great game.  Making his case again to start.  Fast and reading the ball well
Jacob - a better performance.  Needs to stop trying for goal, and concentrate on better crosses
Fortune - the rust is starting to come off.  Much better perfromance this week.  can be doing more
Amaro - can't really find a fault in his performance. Enjoying his play.  
Sanchez - I think his play depends on who's next to him.  His play goes up with better midfielders
Almirón - I'm of two minds here.  the 1st half, he played too deep.  Pushed up higher in the 2nd.  Much better higher.  Getting open, good distribution, making runs.  But should have put more balls on target.  He should have scored. 
Miranchuk - Didn't make an impact in the 1st half.  The 2nd half is what we need from him.  Great movement and distribution.  It conincides with him moving more central.
Embolo - not a good performance.  He was constantly double marked, and he starting playing deeper as a result.  But too often, he played as a CAM rather than a striker.  His decision not to follow Picault in a run prevented a golden opportunity

subs:
Edwards - He raised Atlanta's attack on the right.  he's getting better in getting the ball up and across
Gill - He has the potential for something special.  I want him to start.  He read the ball very well.  Passes well.  But he's great under pressure on both attack and defense.  He doesn't just keep the ball, he is not afraid to try tricks. And they're working.
Muyumba - I liked what I saw from him tonight.  A chaotic hard worker.  Is able to get the ball higher when he's not under pressure
Picault - just a couple of good runs.  Otherwise, didn't provide much of an impact
Brennan - oh so close to the winner.  Made a good impact when he came on.  DIdn't have enough time.
